query: EXPLAIN MATCH (c:V01 {uid:'V01:S05'})-[r:BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT]->(p) RETURN c.uid AS courtyard,p.uid AS participant,p.name AS name,r.uid AS relationshipUid,r.boundaryId AS boundaryId,r.participantRole AS role,r.analysisSliceZM AS sliceZM,r.referenceLengthM AS lengthM,r.solidIntervalBoundsM AS intervals,r.netContributionM AS netContributionM ORDER BY boundaryId,participant
